meetingNotes.title: R.Houselander-Cook - Attractive Champs
meetingNotes.content:
I asked Ronnie - "If you were to be attracted back to the programme what would you like to see, and what to avoid?"

Ronnie's response:
- Time is an issue
- Work on Digital things in CPD time, like Inset days
- Use directed time to focus on making shiny exemplars, or innovate and experiment. Making this additional to role is difficult.
- Don't give us projects - we don't like it.
- Take us out on CPD events

meetingNotes.title: BM - Catch Up
meetingNotes.content:
Initial meeting regarding my role as Digital Pedagogy Coach within Quality.
Don't want to box me in to "just" digital. I need to develop my wider understanding of the work of Quality and to assist in all areas across the team.

Key Discussion Points:
1) EIF Toolkit - How can I support students to learn the Digital skills needed to learn - Provide the evidence of this.
This is a vitally important part of the toolkit, and the same statement about digital is mentioned several times. I paraphrase... "to develop the English, Maths, and Digital Skills to learn and develop subject knowledge".

2) What is happening with Digital across the organisation?
- Digital Hours - current and future. What is going towards them? NB - Look at the Business Planning guide from Ben Knocks - shared by BM
- What the EXPECTATIONS of digital skills development?
- Currently happening with digital and what are the Gaps?
- What can be celebrated and shared?
- What equipment do Areas currently have?
- What is their wish list?
- Work with R. Browne in Bids to explore money streams
- Assistive Technology and Digital Inclusion practice - work with Lois K and Liz - include digital accessibility
- Learn about Assistive Tech - what gaps do we have and how can we plug them?
- Talk to Joe A about his experience and insight into Digital across the college
